The premise of the question is incorrect. No female artist topped Spotify's global most-streamed artists list for three consecutive years from 2020–2022. That period was dominated by Bad Bunny, who held the #1 spot all three years (and again in 2025, for a record four times).

The first woman to top the overall Spotify most-streamed artists list was Taylor Swift, who claimed the #1 position in 2023 and 2024. She was the highest-ranked female artist during 2020–2022 but did not reach the top spot until 2023.
